decision: Scan set: Drive 'Mazda Miata ND' / Scan folder; full car = 'ND Miata ND Full Car.stl' (2026-11-10, 25.0M tris) + all 2026-10-29 part/state scans + the 2026-08-04 'ND Trunk Closed/Half Open/Open' lids
why: Brief suggested this full car; the 10-29 states are the complete set listed in the brief; the Aug trunk lids are candidates for the trunk-opening move (registration to be checked)

decision: Levelling: raw Artec frame is upside down (ground at +Z, long axis X). One rigid transform (180 deg about X, then the Huracan RANSAC ground-plane levelling) in tools/level.py -> /home/user/media/work/miata/level.json, applied to every scan
why: One shared rigid transform keeps every state registered; leveled car is 3908 mm long (ND spec 3915 mm) and 1218 mm tall, nose at -Y and car's right at -X (house frame) - confirmed on a 5-angle silver render

decision: Canonical normalisation = ive prep of car4_clean.stl (levelled, ive crop) -> /home/user/media/work/miata/prep/car4.json; every other scan prepped with --like car4.json
why: Lesson: never re-normalise a part separately

decision: Registration: every 2026-10-29 state/part scan used at identity in the levelled frame (tools/regcheck.py + red-over-grey renders in /home/user/media/work/miata/reg)
why: Median part-to-car distance 1.2-3.0 mm for state scans; front bumper 4.8 mm median (78 % overlap) and the red overlay sits on the car's bumper; ICP corrections are rotations about far pivots that do not improve the overlay, so no transforms applied (all prepped --like car4.json)

decision: 2026-08-04 'ND Trunk Closed/Half Open/Open' scans not used
why: Different frame: 2-3 % overlap with the car within 15 mm, median 7.7 mm on what does overlap - not the same registered surfaces

decision: 'Side Skirt Off, Door Open' not used for a door move
why: Looked at it: it captured the door jamb, A-pillar and sill only - the open door itself is not in the scan, so a door-opening move would have to invent the door

decision: No isolated hood or trunk-lid scan exists: hood and trunk lid cut from the full-car skin along their shut lines, traced on a near-orthographic top render (tools/extract.py; polygons in the editlog command lines)
why: Distance diffs against the state scans also flag fenders/wheels (car was on stands), so a geometric seam trace is the clean separation; shut lines are crisp in the 3 mm render

decision: Hood/trunk hinges fitted from the panels captured propped open in the state scans (tools/hinge.py): hood pivot y -0.458 z 0.889 m (prepped), opens 43.7 deg (fit median 3.0 mm); trunk lid pivot y 1.336 z 0.987 m, opens 85.7 deg (7.6 mm, from 'Rear End Trunk Open Bumper Removed')
why: Panels end their opening move exactly at the pose the scanner saw, so motion is physically right instead of a guessed pivot

decision: Side skirt part = car triangles on the right sill (between the arches) more than 8 mm from 'Side Skirt Off' and within 200 mm of it; mirrors part = 'Mirrors Only' split at the car centreline
why: No isolated skirt scan; the diff in a sill box gives a clean strip (checked in a side projection). Mirrors Only is registered (1.3 mm median)

decision: Composites (projects/ferrari-296/tools/composite.py, cut 12 mm): comp_front = car - hood - front bumper + 'Bumper Off Hood Open' minus its open hood; comp_rear = car - trunk lid - rear bumper + 'Trunk Open Bumper Removed' minus lid + 'Rear bumper removed trunk closed'; comp_explode = all panels incl. skirt + mirrors removed, + skirt-off (jack stands dropped below the skirt line) + 'Mirrors Removed'
why: Lesson: state scans as captured over the trimmed full car. Checked closed (reads as the stock car) and open (engine bay / trunk interior real scan detail) in silver and red-part renders

decision: Shot order: s1 front 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear 3/4 orbit (other side) -> s3 front-right wheel close-up (2 mm) -> s4 headlight/grille slide (2 mm) -> s5 front bumper slides off + hood opens -> s6 rear bumper slides off + trunk opens -> s7 rise to top-down -> s8 exploded (separate, drift, reassemble) -> logo
why: Brief's Temerario order: turntables/orbits, extreme close-ups, hood/trunk open where state scans allow, top-down, exploded, logo. The Miata's wheels ARE scanned (6-spoke wheel with brake behind), so the wheel close-up is real data

decision: s6: camera on the car's right-rear (232->214 deg) and the rear bumper slides back+right+down
why: First preview flew the bumper straight at the lens and hid the trunk opening (lesson: keep parts from flying at the lens)

decision: s8 exploded: parts stack UP (hood +0.95 m, trunk +0.85, bumpers +0.7/0.75 and only 0.3 m out, mirrors out+up, skirt out) with a high front-3/4 arc -32 -> -78 deg, 6.1 m
why: First preview pushed bumpers 0.75 m along the car and side-on framing lost them off the 9:16 edges; Temerario 25-31 s floats panels in layers above the car

decision: Timing-independent shots (s1, s2, s3, s4, s7) rendered before the music arrived at estimated lengths; action shots (s5, s6, s8) wait for the track so their moves are keyed to its accents
why: Brief: do scan prep and renders until the track arrives; smooth camera moves can be retimed a few percent with src_fps, part motion keyed on beats cannot

decision: Music: mazda-miata-nd_track.mp3 (original, generated for this car by the parent session). Measured with ive beats + tools/music_scan.py: 116.01 BPM, beat 0.51721 s, grid anchored on the first kick peak 8.336 s (residual p50 1.5 ms); 0-8.3 s pads only, kicks from 8.336 (even beats = strong kick accents), lift to a louder section 15.6-16.6 s, last hit 33.162 s, decay to -40 dB at 36.6 s
why: Lessons: anchor on kick peaks, cut on accents, measure where a generated track really ends (parent estimated 117.5 BPM / end ~33.3 s; ive beats said 117.5 but the kick spacing over 47 beats is 0.5172 s)

decision: Timeline: music starts at 4.198 s (8 beats before the first kick, 0.3 s fade-in); cuts on 8/4-beat phrase accents at video frames 124 (first kick 8.336), 248, 310, 372 (16.611 section lift), 497, 621, 683, logo at 869 (33.162 last hit); end 972 (32.4 s, music at -40 dB). s5/s6: bumper slides beats 0-2, hood/trunk opens beats 2-6; s8: separate on the cut (26.955), lands beat 2, drift, return from beat 6, LOCK on beat 10 (32.127 kick), hold 2 beats
why: A slow turntable carries the 8-beat pad intro (Temerario opens slow) so the first cut lands on the first kick instead of cutting in the quiet; every motion starts/lands on an even-beat kick; video trimmed to where the music ends

decision: Look: house silver (shot.py mat_silver, AgX, bg 0.004) at 0 EV; no exposure change
why: Measured s1 car-pixel luma median 199-203 / p90 240-249 vs Temerario ref ~200 / 231; background renders RGB 7 = logo card black

decision: Licence plate embossing flattened onto its fitted plane in the car (car4np) and the rear bumper part (tools/flatten_plate.py); s2 re-rendered
why: The 75 % s2 render showed partly legible plate characters on the customer's car; the plate shape stays, the characters do not read (checked in a crop)

decision: Render with Cycles persistent data OFF (tools/shot.py = copy of the ferrari-296 shot tool with a 'persistent' spec flag, default off); s5 frames 36-64 re-rendered
why: With persistent data on, the s5 animation lost all lighting from frame 36 (car mean luma 43 -> 5) while a fresh render of the same frame was lit; checked every frame's mean luma of s1-s4 (no drop)

decision: s7 re-shot: rise from a high rear-left 3/4 to ~12 deg off vertical from behind, never straight overhead
why: v1 passed straight over the car and to_track_quat's up vector flipped: the image rolled ~90 deg in one frame before the cut (frame 682) and minterpolate ghosted it

decision: v2 cut grid anchored on the broadband kick ONSET (1 ms RMS half-rise) = 8.305 s track time, 31.8 ms before the low-band kick peak used in v1
why: User v2 rule: measure cuts against the decoded audio's broadband onset; v1 cuts measured +16..+23 ms late on clear beats (projects/infiniti-qx80/tools/cutcheck.py on miata_nd_v2.mp4), median onset-peak offset 31.8 ms over 32 beats

decision: v3 scene order from the scene-director agent (direction.md, director.md): whole-car front 3/4 opener -> headlight (s4 reuse) -> front bumper off + inner face + crash beam -> hood to captured open pose / engine bay -> front wheel (s3 reversed) -> right mirror + sill skirt -> rear bumper off + inner face + exhaust/rear structure -> trunk to captured pose -> progressive explode (front angle, rear angle) -> reassembly on the last hit -> fade -> small logo
why: User v2 brief + addendum: order by scan features, travel front->side->rear without ping-pong, bumper-removed states are the hero beats, one continuous sequence per section, progressive explode, fade then small logo

decision: Cut from v1: s1 (cropped), s2 (same view as s1, IoU 0.79), s5/s6 (too wide, outer faces only, open-panel undersides with no data faced the lens), s7 (rotation onto hood speckle), s8 (everything separating at once in one wide orbit)
why: User v2 rules 2-4 and addendum A/B; ive director flagged s1~s2

decision: Framing iterated on 30 % previews with an edge-touch check per first/mid/last frame: opener car 10-91 % of width (v1 cropped); bumpers turn their inner face on the camera's sight line below the nose/tail then sink out of frame during the push-in; parked bumpers left out of later shots; explode cameras pulled back to 6.0-6.4 m
why: Addendum A: whole car in wide shots, nothing clipped by accident, no dead black where the subject should be

decision: Hood and trunk openings kept: both end exactly on a registered open-state capture ('Bumper Off Hood Open' hinge fit 3.0 mm; 'Rear End Trunk Open Bumper Removed' 7.6 mm); cameras never see the panels' missing undersides
why: Addendum D allows openings only where a registered open-state scan exists - both do on this car; no door shot (no door data)

decision: Labels (Remotion ScanHUD, burned in after assembly): FRONT BUMPER REMOVED / INNER FACE · MOUNTING POINTS, CRASH BEAM / FRONT BUMPER OFF, REAR BUMPER REMOVED / INNER FACE, EXHAUST / REAR BUMPER OFF; ENGINE BAY dropped, REAR CRASH BAR not used

decision: Logo card 300 px (was 860) after a 0.4 s fade from the reassembly lock; music cut from 6.2354 s, ends at 29.5 s on the decay
